panels.panel_visual_description: Character A is framed in a medium close-up against a blurred purple and blue geometric background. She wears a tailored blue blazer and has long, wavy black hair. Her expression is bright and engaging as she looks directly forward. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting her 3D-animated features. She appears to be speaking directly to the viewer.

Character B is seated cross-legged on a woven mat in a warmly lit room. She wears a simple brown top and has long black hair. She is actively massaging oil into her scalp and hair. The background features dark wooden furniture and small decorative items. The camera captures her in a relaxed, medium shot.

scenes.visual_description: The screen is split horizontally into two equal halves. The top half features a 3D-animated female avatar speaking directly to the camera. The bottom half shows a real human woman applying oil to her hair in a cozy room. Large, bold text overlays in Tamil and English appear dynamically over both panels. The text translates the spoken dialogue and changes rapidly to match the conversation.
